item.title: Mark Your Calendars: Fall 2026 NIH National Advisory Council or Board (NACs) Meetings
item.description: We are sharing upcoming NIH National Advisory Council or Board (NAC) meetings for your awareness. A portion of NAC meeting proceedings are open to the public. Viewers can hear Institute or Center Director remarks, updates on priorities and initiatives, budget overviews, scientific highlights, and concept clearance for future possible funding opportunities.

item.title: Submitting Applications with International Collaborations
item.description: In 2025, we announced an updated NIH Policy on Foreign Subawards (NOT-OD-25-104) and introduced the Collaborative International Research application and award structure using the PF5 activity code (NOT-OD-25-155) which was implemented earlier this year.

item.title: When Are Two Heads Better Than One? Considerations When Using the NIH Multiple Principal Investigator Model
item.description: Nearly two decades ago, we began allowing more than one researcher to be designated as program director/principal investigator on a single grant award. The multiple PD/PI (MPI) model can provide important benefits, including giving each investigator credit as an NIH-designated PD/PI, but it is not required to conduct collaborative or team science. Here, we revisit when multiple PD/PIs may make sense, as well as some of the responsibilities and potential drawbacks investigators should consider.

item.title: How Do I Address Potential Foreign Risks in My Small Business Program Application?
item.description: The Small Business Innovation and Economic Security Act strengthens the government’s ability to prevent adversarial nations from exploiting federally funded technologies. Here we offer a practical guide to help small businesses avoid security risks from foreign countries of concern when applying.
